channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: One Dead After MO House Explosion
item.description: One person died in a house fire and explosion in Smithville on Wednesday. Multiple fire districts responded, and the Missouri State Fire Marshal's Office will investigate.

item.title: NY Firefighters Rescue Trapped Resident From Burning Building
item.description: A two-alarm kitchen fire at Royal Garden Apartments in Town of Ulster displaced 11 residents. Firefighters rescued one trapped resident, and the Red Cross provided aid to 15 affected individuals.

item.title: MA Fire Marshal Warns Businesses Against Illegal Sparklers, Pyrotechnics
item.description: Massachusetts officials issued a warning against illegal sparklers and pyrotechnics following a deadly fire in Switzerland, highlighting safety risks and legal consequences for violations.

item.title: Bristol (VA) Chooses 25-Year Veteran as New Fire Chief
item.description: Bristol Virginia Fire Department's Battalion Chief Donald "Stacey" Farley was appointed as the new fire chief, succeeding Mike Armstrong.

item.title: Man Who Sparked Fatal Bronx (NY) Gas Explosion by Stealing Stove Planned to Trade It for Crack: Prosecutors
item.description: Samuel Calderon faces murder charges for a Bronx explosion and fire.

item.title: St. Louis Firefighters Rescue Dog From Icy Water; Video Goes Viral
item.description: On January 29, the St. Louis Fire Department rescued a dog that fell through ice in freezing temperatures. The dog is recovering well after the quick response from the Marine Rescue Task Force.

item.title: MA Firefighters Battle Two-Alarm Fire Amid Freezing Conditions
item.description: A two-alarm fire at a home on Otis St. in Lowell caused significant damage but no injuries. Firefighters faced challenges from cold weather and snow while battling the fire.

item.title: Fire Chiefs Fault Local Leadership as US Senate Probes Palisades (CA) Fire
item.description: Emergency response leaders testified that failures in local leadership, not firefighters, led to the Palisades fire's devastation, highlighting issues in preparedness and command oversight.

item.title: One Dead as Early-Morning Fire Strikes Brooklyn (NY) Apartment Building
item.description: A fire in a Brooklyn apartment building early Thursday resulted in one death and displaced a resident.

item.title: Triaging a Lost Bail Anchor
item.description: No amount of preparation or technology can account for a lost anchor. Alex Degnan on immediate options for the best chance at an effective bail.
